summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K with routine regulatory announcements: monthly voting rights and capital disclosures, issuance of shares under its Sharesave Scheme, PDMR transaction notifications, weekly transactions in own shares (buybacks), half-year report, and a share buyback programme. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or restructuring is present. The share buyback programme is a capital return but is routine and ongoing. The half-year report is ordinary operational disclosure. The filing is purely informational under Rule 13a-16.
